bug_semantics: Authenticated Meteor DDP methods getThreadsList(rid) and getThreadMessages(tmid) take room/thread identifiers as raw untyped values and pass those same values into Mongo queries. Rooms.findOneById / Messages.findOneById wrap the argument as {_id: <param>}, so an operator object such as {"$gt":"4"} makes the authorization lookup return some document the caller can already access; the downstream query (Messages.findThreadsByRoomId(rid) = find({rid, tcount:{$exists:true}}) and Messages.findVisibleThreadByThreadId(tmid) = find({tmid, _hidden:{$ne:true}})) then fans the operator across all rooms, leaking private thread parents and their replies. REST /v1/chat.getThreadsList already rejects non-string rid via AJV and queries with room._id; the DDP twins did not.
flaw_origin: The dual-use untyped-id pattern was first written when Threads V1 added DDP methods getThreads and getThread in GitHub PR #13996 member 4126d14b92f30790d97d66b5d7188749e18b7d05 (2019-03-29, Guilherme Gazzo). getThreads did Rooms.findOneById(rid) then Messages.find({rid, tcount:{$exists:true}}); getThread did Messages.findOne({_id:tmid}) then Messages.find({tmid}). Later members only renamed the methods to getThreadsList/getThreadMessages, moved the rid query into findThreadsByRoomId(rid), and the 2019-04-07 squash 14b79fe1acd1c73e13603a882d5f7f64fcc23688 carried that mechanism onto develop. The v5.0 REST AJV string check (HackerOne #1446767) never landed on DDP.

Advisory/CVE: Meteor DDP getThreadsList and getThreadMessages accept rid/tmid with no schema validation; Mongo operator substitution lets auth resolve to an accessible room while the data query fans out. REST chat.getThreadsList was given rid:{type:'string'} in v5.0 (HackerOne #1446767); DDP was not. Fix PR https://github.com/RocketChat/Rocket.Chat/pull/41814.

No typeof/string check.

reasoning: CVE-2026-65645/GHSA-gw74-gwm4-8crp is a published CWE-20 NoSQL operator-injection on Rocket.Chat DDP thread fetchers, not a withdrawn advisory. The exploitable mechanism is the first-write of untyped rid/tmid used both for canAccessRoom lookup and for the subsequent Messages query, so an operator object authorizes against one accessible room while reading threads/replies from all rooms. git log --follow on the current DDP files bottoms at squash 14b79fe1acd1c73e13603a882d5f7f64fcc23688; that squash is not the BIC. Public PR #13996 members reconstruct the first add of getThreads.js/getThread.js as 4126d14b92f30790d97d66b5d7188749e18b7d05, whose parent 91f5fb2f550bff46acb3937930c598685eb483e1 lacks those files. Later members/refactors (rename to getThreadsList/getThreadMessages, findThreadsByRoomId helper, TypeScript/async/monorepo moves) preserved the raw-parameter sink; they are not first-writes. The v5.0 REST AJV rid:string patch closed a parallel HTTP surface and left DDP unpatched, which is incomplete coverage of an already-vulnerable 2019 method, not a new BIC. Fix ea163f56b53b1dd40d49af39e0406397cbd24939 (#41814) is the develop landing that adds typeof string checks and canonical document ids; it is contained in 8.8.0-rc.0 and backported onto the advisory patch tags, while 8.7.0 still has the intro and not this fix. AI attribution is judged only on 4126d14: 2019 human author/committer, no commit-object AI marker, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
